incident_name: US East 1 - Unity Catalog (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
Impact Summary:
Between 19 February 2026 23:17 UTC and 20 February 2026 00:23 UTC, Unity Catalog in AWS us-east-1 experienced failures processing data access and metadata requests.

Symptoms:
Customers experienced
- Errors or timeouts when accessing tables, schemas, or catalogs governed by Unity Catalog
- Failures when running queries or jobs that relied on Unity Catalog for data access

Current Status:
This incident has been fully resolved as of 20 February 2026 00:23 UTC. Normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update:
No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
